description: No automerge for Plex's own version, not even at the patch level: Plex Media Server is proprietary, has no auditable migration history, and upgrades the operator's library database in place and forward-only on the first start of a new build, which a fresh-install Molecule run structurally cannot see. What Molecule does gate is that the pinned version runs: the scenario asserts that the version Plex reports over /identity is the `plex_version` that defaults/main.yml pins.

`versioning=semver` is what keeps the lookup honest among the 2048 tags in linuxserver/plex: it rejects the four-component `X.Y.Z.BBBB-<hash>-lsNNN` builds and the `version-*`, `bionic-*` and arch-prefixed families, leaving the 63 curated three-component tags. `versioning=loose` would pick `1.43.3.10896-cb3ebc72d-ls321` instead, so this must not be relaxed.
